what: A portrait photo card starts folded into a 10em dot (a small rounded-corner square) at the center, and when the card’s top edge touches 80% of the screen it opens to full size over .8s, the photo inside settles from 1.1 → 1 over .6s after .2s, and the border panel (text) above the photo turns on after .6s over .3s sine.out. Even after opening, the photo drifts slowly from −6.25em to 6.25em as the card passes through the screen (scrub .8) — a section where step photo columns bloom one by one.

options.ease: Spreading curve, default power1.out (original IX3 default)
options.shift: Distance over which images drift slowly (CSS length, same amount up and down), default 6.25em — 0 means no drift
options.[data-fx-part=clip]: Opening panel (required) — its own css size is the size at the fully open end
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (optional) photo that settles from 1.1 to 1 and flows late
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (If present) Text and border panel that turns on last

note: The panel size grows via width·height (not scale) — the photo inside doesn’t stretch and looks cropped as it emerges from the center. The panel’s parent must be center-aligned (flex center) so the dots spread out from the center (the css handles this).
